title: andrographis glandulosa
intro: Andrographis glandulosa, commonly known as Himalayan king of bitters, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region and parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Andrographis glandulosa include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities, making it a potential treatment for respiratory and gastrointestinal infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include andrographolide, neoandrographolide, and 14-deoxyandrographolide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
